That moment was very embarrassing and painful for me. Then my friend suggested me to use SpeakX. Daily 10-15 minutes practice, simple and practical lessons that are useful in different daily situations. Today, I can not only read English but also speak it confidently. And now when my child asks something, I can explain it to him without stopping, and his marks are also improving. All thanks to SpeakX. Not just English, but the support of my confidence.]
